content.title: 6-1-5-2. Additional standards for detached permanent signs.
content.summary:
A.	Generally. The standards of this Section apply to permanent signs that are not attached to buildings. These standards are applied in conjunction with all other applicable standards of this Article.
B.	Detached Permanent Signs.

faqs.q: 6-1-5-2. Additional standards for detached permanent signs.
faqs.a:
A.	Generally. The standards of this Section apply to permanent signs that are not attached to buildings. These standards are applied in conjunction with all other applicable standards of this Article.
B.	Detached Permanent Signs. Detached permanent signs are allowed according to the standards in Table 6-1-5-2, Detached Permanent Signs. The location of detached permanent signs may be restricted by Section 6-1-3-1, Prohibited Signs and Sign Elements.
(Ord. No. 4793, § 5, 3-21-2022; Ord. No. 4851, § 4, 7-10-2023)
